scope: Independent English-only audit of six completed CT2 small/base workers; no Spanish raw workers read.

normalization.description: NFKC + casefold; Unicode punctuation becomes spaces; whitespace collapsed; accents and digits retained; no number expansion, STT corrections or reference-dependent rewriting

method.wer: Independent full-matrix word Levenshtein; exact-match diagonal, substitution/deletion/insertion ties. All 300 stored row counts matched; aggregate errors/words within each worker.
method.terms: Recomputed unique glossary phrases per original reference and normalized whole-word/phrase hits against hash-matched frozen glossary.
method.read_limitations: JSON and small source/glossary text only. Stored audio/model hashes checked for internal consistency, not recomputed from audio/weights. Parent independently audits bilingual provenance.
method.execution: No runtime/model imports, tests, audio/devices, Git or inference.

decision: English base fails WER in all three repeats; no English base replay implementation under this gate.
